objective: Prevent benchmark models from using catalog text, maker marks, release codes, character names, multi-panel product graphics, or other non-geometry shortcuts.
invariant: A verified source image is reference evidence, not automatically benchmark-ready model input.
approval_gate: Byte verification does not grant benchmark model-input approval.
A model-ready asset must remove or mask forbidden text cues and task-confounding panels.
Sanitized derivatives must preserve source SHA-256, transformation parameters, derivative SHA-256 and reviewer provenance.
Held-out split assignment stays inherited from the parent case; sanitization must never create cross-split copies.
Do not use OCR-derived release or character labels as model features even when OCR is used only to find mask regions.

source_risk_priors.reason: Usually isolated catalog figure photography/renders, but insets or alternate-expression panels can still confound a single-view task.
Source media frequently preserves manufacturer product-card layouts with codes, names, logos, insets, accessories, or multiple views.
Retailer-hosted product media may preserve manufacturer labels, codes, comparison figures, or composite layouts.

model_input_rule: Only sanitized_asset_status=approved may enter benchmark model inputs. Raw verified references remain evidence/provenance sources.
